headline: How to Get Glacy
title: How to Get Glacy in Aniimo | Evolve Pranky with a Wave Stone | Aniimo Guide
video_script: Want Glacy, the Water healer in Aniimo? You can find it in the wild in Sea of Flowers and Driftwise Meadow. Or evolve it yourself. Take a Pranky to level twenty and use one Wave Stone, and it becomes Glacy. The Sea of Flowers and Snowfield Pranky evolve the same way into their own Glacy forms. Which healer is on your team right now? Comment below!

scenes.sub: Sea of Flowers and Driftwise Meadow

description: Glacy in Aniimo can be caught in Sea of Flowers or Driftwise Meadow, or evolved from Pranky at level twenty with one Wave Stone.
